snippet.title: Summon a Sweetheart (All Endings) – You Try to Summon a Girlfriend, But Get a Grotesque Monster
snippet.description:
Summon a Sweetheart All Endings – You Try to Summon a Girlfriend, But Get a Grotesque Monster

Game Download : Summon a Sweetheart
https://inkyblinkyarts.itch.io/summon-a-sweetheart

00:00 Intro & Prologue
01:30 Summoning a GF Using a Forbidden Book
08:11 Finding Gifts for the Monster Around the Room
12:50 Ending 5 - Lost in the sludge (Bad Ending)
17:11 Ending 11 - Too much, too soon (Bad End)
18:01 Ending 8 - Covers and Books (Bad Ending)
20:33 Ending 7 - Trash Disposal Of The Heart (Bad Ending)
22:19 ENDING 2 - A Glimpse Inside (NEUTRAL ENDING)
24:37 Ending 10 - STRRRRRRIKE (Bad End)
25:49 Ending 1 - Smooth Brained, Single Celled (Bad Ending)
27:39 ENDING 6 - Codependent (GOOD ENDING)
37:40 Ending 4 - Monster vs Monster (Bad Ending)
39:02 Ending 3 - It's never 'just' water (Bad Ending)

About The Game :
You try to summon a girlfriend using a strange ritual… but things go horribly wrong.
In Summon a Sweetheart, love doesn’t come easy instead, you’re faced with a disturbing creature that demands twisted gifts.

Every choice leads to different outcomes, from bizarre to deeply unsettling.
This video includes all endings, showing every possible outcome in this weird and disturbing indie horror game.
